description: Find broken links on a web page: fetches the page, collects its links (internal and external) and checks up to 50 of them in parallel, reporting status code, redirect target and response time for each, with a summary of broken, redirected and healthy links. Price: 0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. How to call it: get_example {"tool":"broken_links"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/links?url=https%3A%2F%2Fyruz.one%2F
name: broken_links
title: YRUZ Broken Link Check (0.01 USDC)
